The '''light repeating blaster''' or '''light repeating blaster rifle''' was a heavy [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]-type [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon carried by military personnel.

==Description==
The light repeating blaster was a lighter version of a regular [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]]. This weapon was legally restricted to military use in most instances.

One of the most widespread light repeating blasters was the [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 model]] used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Other models were used by heavily-armed infantry troopers in various armies, including the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].

A typical power capacity for a light repeating blaster was 30 blasts. Light repeating blasters were more powerful than typical blasters, but the high rate of fire meant that it was easy for the user to waste its blasts. A power generator could be connected to this weapon for longer use.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Slight differences in this weapon's range is presented in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]], namely, an optimum range of up to 45 meters and a maximum range of up to 450 meters. In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]], its range was lower, at 28 meters.
